from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageEnhance, ImageFilter

from preflight_check import run_preflight, check_draft_plaintext
from compile_spec_to_capcut import populate_draft_materials

BASE_DIR = pathlib.Path(r"C:\Users\bssho\Downloads\paperclip-master\video-automation")
WORK_DIR = BASE_DIR / "work"
CT_MEDIA_DIR = WORK_DIR / "media" / "cybertruck"
FRAMES_DIR = WORK_DIR / "frames"
STAGE_DIR = WORK_DIR / "capcut_stage"
SPECS_DIR = BASE_DIR / "strategy" / "specs"
SHORTFORM_SPECS_DIR = SPECS_DIR / "shortform"
LONGFORM_SPECS_DIR = SPECS_DIR / "longform"
DRAFT_ROOT = pathlib.Path(r"C:\Users\bssho\AppData\Local\CapCut\User Data\Projects\com.lveditor.draft")
TEMPLATE_1D42_PATH = DRAFT_ROOT / "26 폴스타4 옵틱 [26.03.13]" / "Timelines" / "1D4243F2-179F-43c2-AC12-977981653637" / "draft_content.json"
DL_DIR = pathlib.Path(r"C:\Users\bssho\Downloads")
AUDIO_DIR = DL_DIR / "No Copyright Edit Audio"
CLOUD_FILES_DIR = pathlib.Path(r"C:\Users\bssho\AppData\Local\CapCut\User Data\Cloud files")
ONLINE_MAT_DIR = pathlib.Path(r"C:\Users\bssho\AppData\Local\CapCut\User Data\Cache\onlineMaterial")
FC_EXE = r"C:\Program Files\FilmCraft\filmcraft-cli.exe"
FC_DATA = WORK_DIR / "filmcraft-data"
FONT_BOLD_PATH = r"C:\Users\bssho\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Windows\Fonts\NotoSansKR-Bold-Static.ttf"

for d in (CT_MEDIA_DIR, FRAMES_DIR, STAGE_DIR, SPECS_DIR, SHORTFORM_SPECS_DIR, LONGFORM_SPECS_DIR):
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


def run_ffmpeg(args):
    cmd = ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error"] + args
    subprocess.run(cmd, check=True)


def compose_full_mirror_16x9(src_img: pathlib.Path, out_png: pathlib.Path, grayscale: bool = False, fill_mode: str = "studio"):
    """
    Composes a 1920x1080 (16:9) frame for Long-Form template without ANY Short-Form red/green border boxes
    or black pillarbox bars, while keeping 100% of the side mirror housing & glass visible.
    """
    im = Image.open(src_img).convert("RGB")
    if grayscale:
        im = im.convert("L").convert("RGB")

    if fill_mode == "hero_16x9":
        # 1200x600 Cybertruck hero -> fill 1920x1080 using soft blurred ambient extension at top/bottom 60px
        bg = im.resize((1920, 1080), Image.Resampling.BICUBIC).filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius=28))
        bg = ImageEnhance.Brightness(bg).enhance(0.45)
        fg = im.resize((1920, 960), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
        bg.paste(fg, (0, 60))
        bg.save(out_png)
        return

    if fill_mode == "cybertruck_side_profile":
        # Left half of 사이버트럭 리사.jpg shows the matte-black Cybertruck side profile & triangular mirror
        w, h = im.size
        crop = im.crop((0, int(h * 0.12), int(w * 0.50), int(h * 0.88)))
        bg = crop.resize((1920, 1080), Image.Resampling.BICUBIC).filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius=32))
        bg = ImageEnhance.Brightness(bg).enhance(0.38)
        scale = min(1760 / crop.width, 980 / crop.height)
        nw, nh = int(crop.width * scale), int(crop.height * scale)
        fg = crop.resize((nw, nh), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
        bg.paste(fg, ((1920 - nw) // 2, (1080 - nh) // 2))
        bg.save(out_png)
        return

    # Default 'studio' full-mirror composition (e.g. 광각미러전 테슬라.jpg, 광각미러후 테슬라.jpg)
    bg = im.resize((1920, 1080), Image.Resampling.BICUBIC).filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius=36))
    bg = ImageEnhance.Brightness(bg).enhance(0.35)
    scale = min(1560 / im.width, 940 / im.height)
    nw, nh = int(im.width * scale), int(im.height * scale)
    fg = im.resize((nw, nh), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    bg.paste(fg, ((1920 - nw) // 2, (1080 - nh) // 2))
    bg.save(out_png)


def compose_split_50x50_16x9(left_img: pathlib.Path, right_img: pathlib.Path, out_png: pathlib.Path, left_bw: bool = True):
    """
    Creates an authentic OpticGlass Long-Form 50:50 edge-to-edge split screen (1920x1080):
    - Left half (0..960, 0..1080): 시공 전 (100% of stock mirror visible, desaturated B&W look like tpl1_45s.jpg)
    - Right half (960..1920, 0..1080): 시공 후 (100% of OpticGlass wide-angle mirror visible, vivid color)
    - Clean 4px white center divider line at x=960 (no Short-Form red/green border boxes).
    """
    canvas = Image.new("RGB", (1920, 1080), (16, 18, 22))
    im_l = Image.open(left_img).convert("RGB")
    if left_bw:
        im_l = im_l.convert("L").convert("RGB")
    im_r = Image.open(right_img).convert("RGB")

    for side_idx, im in enumerate((im_l, im_r)):
        x_offset = 0 if side_idx == 0 else 960
        # Soft ambient fill for the 960x1080 half
        half_bg = im.resize((960, 1080), Image.Resampling.BICUBIC).filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius=28))
        half_bg = ImageEnhance.Brightness(half_bg).enhance(0.32)
        canvas.paste(half_bg, (x_offset, 0))
        # Fit 100% of the mirror image inside 920x920 centered in the 960x1080 panel
        scale = min(920 / im.width, 920 / im.height)
        nw, nh = int(im.width * scale), int(im.height * scale)
        fg = im.resize((nw, nh), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
        px = x_offset + (960 - nw) // 2
        py = (1080 - nh) // 2
        canvas.paste(fg, (px, py))

    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
    draw.line([(960, 0), (960, 1080)], fill=(255, 255, 255), width=4)
    canvas.save(out_png)


def image_to_mp4(img_path: pathlib.Path, out_mp4: pathlib.Path, dur_s: float, zoom: bool = False):
    frames = max(1, int(round(dur_s * 30)))
    if zoom:
        vf = (
            f"scale=1920:1080:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,"
            f"pad=1920:1080:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:black,"
            f"zoompan=z='min(zoom+0.0007,1.05)':x='iw/2-(iw/zoom/2)':y='ih/2-(ih/zoom/2)':d={frames}:s=1920x1080:fps=30,setsar=1"
        )
        run_ffmpeg([
            "-loop", "1", "-i", str(img_path),
            "-t", f"{dur_s:.3f}",
            "-vf", vf,
            "-c:v", "libx264", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-r", "30",
            str(out_mp4),
        ])
    else:
        vf = "scale=1920:1080:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=1920:1080:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:black,fps=30,setsar=1"
        run_ffmpeg([
            "-loop", "1", "-framerate", "30", "-i", str(img_path),
            "-t", f"{dur_s:.3f}",
            "-vf", vf,
            "-c:v", "libx264", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-r", "30",
            str(out_mp4),
        ])


def trim_video_16x9(src_video: pathlib.Path, out_mp4: pathlib.Path, ss: float, dur_s: float, speed_pts: float = 1.0):
    vf_parts = []
    if abs(speed_pts - 1.0) > 0.01:
        vf_parts.append(f"setpts={speed_pts:.4f}*PTS")
    vf_parts.append("scale=1920:1080:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=1920:1080:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:black,fps=30,setsar=1")
    vf = ",".join(vf_parts)
    run_ffmpeg([
        "-ss", f"{ss:.3f}", "-i", str(src_video),
        "-t", f"{dur_s:.3f}",
        "-vf", vf,
        "-an",
        "-c:v", "libx264", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-r", "30",
        str(out_mp4),
    ])

def build_filmcraft_longform(prepared_scenes, bgm_path: pathlib.Path):
    print("[3/5] Building & exporting FilmCraft 16:9 Long-Form MP4 (NO black subtitle boxes, authentic stroke style) ...")
    fcproj = WORK_DIR / "filmcraft_cybertruck_longform.fcproj"
    if fcproj.exists():
        fcproj.unlink()

    all_paths = [str(sc["path"].resolve()).replace("\\", "/") for sc in prepared_scenes] + [
        str(bgm_path.resolve()).replace("\\", "/")
    ]
    step1_cmds = [
        {"id": "file.newSequence", "params": {"name": "cybertruck_optic_longform", "width": 1920, "height": 1080, "fps": 30, "video": 5, "audio": 2}},
        {"id": "file.import", "params": {"paths": all_paths}},
    ]
    step1_jsonl = WORK_DIR / "fc_ct_step1.jsonl"
    step1_jsonl.write_text("\n".join(json.dumps(c, ensure_ascii=False) for c in step1_cmds) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    r1 = subprocess.run([FC_EXE, "--data-dir", str(FC_DATA), "--save-as", str(fcproj), "--compact", "run", str(step1_jsonl)], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    lines = [json.loads(line) for line in r1.stdout.strip().splitlines() if line.strip()]
    imported_items = lines[1]["result"]["items"]

    cmds2 = []
    for i, sc in enumerate(prepared_scenes):
        item_id = imported_items[i]
        start_ticks = int(round(sc["start"] * TICKS_PER_SEC))
        dur_ticks = int(round(sc["dur"] * TICKS_PER_SEC))
        cmds2.append({
            "id": "timeline.place",
            "params": {
                "item": item_id,
                "track": "V1",
                "time": start_ticks,
                "duration": dur_ticks,
                "insert": False,
                "video": True,
                "audio": False,
            },
        })

    # Place BGM on A1
    bgm_item_id = imported_items[-1]
    cmds2.append({
        "id": "timeline.place",
        "params": {
            "item": bgm_item_id,
            "track": "A1",

            "duration": int(round(41.5 * TICKS_PER_SEC)),

            "video": False,
            "audio": True,

    # CRITICAL LONG-FORM RULE: background = False, stroke = True (#000000), shadow = True!
    for idx, tb in enumerate(LONGFORM_TEXT_PLAN):

        has_stroke = tb["stroke_w"] > 0

def build_capcut_longform_from_official_template(prepared_scenes, bgm_path: pathlib.Path, alt_bgm_path: pathlib.Path):
    """
    Clones the authentic OpticGlass Long-Form Template (1D4243F2-179F-43c2-AC12-977981653637 from '26 폴스타4 옵틱 [26.03.13]')
    preserving 100% of its CapCut 3D/metallic text effects (花字), text templates ('광각미러가 꼭 필요한 이유', '광각미러 시공 / OPTIC GLASS'),
    transitions, and animations, while swapping the 18 video slots to our 16:9 Cybertruck & Tesla Wide-Angle Mirror clips.
    """
    print("[4/5] Compiling authentic CapCut Long-Form draft from template 1D4243F2 ...")
    dc = json.loads(TEMPLATE_1D42_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    # 1. Fix any foreign user cache paths (C:/Users/wish/ or C:/Users/정민석/) to C:/Users/bssho/
    dc_str = json.dumps(dc, ensure_ascii=False)
    dc_str = dc_str.replace("C:/Users/wish/", "C:/Users/bssho/").replace("C:/Users/정민석/", "C:/Users/bssho/")
    dc = json.loads(dc_str)

    # 2. Map Track 0 (17 main video segments: s00 ~ s16) and Track 7 (1 outro segment: s17)
    vmap = {v["id"]: v for v in dc["materials"]["videos"]}
    smap = {sp["id"]: sp for sp in dc["materials"].get("speeds", [])}

    # Clear redundant split-screen overlay video tracks (Track 1, 2, 4) because s15 & s16 are pre-composed 50:50 split-screen 16:9 MP4s
    for ti in (1, 2, 4):
        if ti < len(dc["tracks"]) and dc["tracks"][ti]["type"] == "video":
            dc["tracks"][ti]["segments"] = []

    main_v_segs = dc["tracks"][0]["segments"]
    outro_v_segs = dc["tracks"][7]["segments"]
    all_target_segs = main_v_segs + outro_v_segs  # 17 + 1 = 18 segments matching prepared_scenes[0..17]

    new_videos_list = []
    for idx, (seg, sc) in enumerate(zip(all_target_segs, prepared_scenes)):
        old_vid = vmap.get(seg["material_id"], {})
        new_vid = copy.deepcopy(old_vid) if old_vid else {}
        new_mat_id = str(uuid.uuid4()).upper()
        dur_us = seg["target_timerange"]["duration"]
        clip_path_str = str(sc["path"].resolve()).replace("\\", "/")

        new_vid["id"] = new_mat_id
        new_vid["path"] = clip_path_str
        new_vid["material_name"] = sc["path"].name
        new_vid["type"] = "video"
        new_vid["width"] = 1920
        new_vid["height"] = 1080
        new_vid["duration"] = dur_us
        new_vid["crop_ratio"] = "free"
        new_vid["crop"] = {
            "upper_left_x": 0.0, "upper_left_y": 0.0,
            "upper_right_x": 1.0, "upper_right_y": 0.0,
            "lower_left_x": 0.0, "lower_left_y": 1.0,
            "lower_right_x": 1.0, "lower_right_y": 1.0,
        }
        new_videos_list.append(new_vid)

        seg["material_id"] = new_mat_id
        seg["source_timerange"] = {"start": 0, "duration": dur_us}
        seg["speed"] = 1.0
        if "clip" in seg and isinstance(seg["clip"], dict):
            seg["clip"]["scale"] = {"x": 1.0, "y": 1.0}
            seg["clip"]["transform"] = {"x": 0.0, "y": 0.0}
        # Reset any speed material refs to 1.0x so source_timerange matches 1:1
        for ref_id in seg.get("extra_material_refs", []):
            if ref_id in smap:
                smap[ref_id]["speed"] = 1.0

    dc["materials"]["videos"] = new_videos_list

    # 3. Update vehicle title texts in materials.texts ("2026 폴스타 4" -> "2026 사이버트럭", "POLESTAR 4" -> "CYBERTRUCK")
    noto_id = "7189852363404874242"
    noto_path = "C:/Users/bssho/AppData/Local/Microsoft/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-Bold-Static.ttf"
    for tx in dc["materials"].get("texts", []):
        cobj = json.loads(tx.get("content") or "{}")
        txt = cobj.get("text", "")
        if "2026 폴스타 4" in txt:
            cobj["text"] = "2026 사이버트럭"
            for st in cobj.get("styles", []):
                st["range"] = [0, len(cobj["text"])]
        elif "POLESTAR 4" in txt:
            cobj["text"] = "CYBERTRUCK"
            for st in cobj.get("styles", []):
                st["range"] = [0, len(cobj["text"])]
        # Ensure background_style is 0 (NO Short-Form black box!)
        tx["background_style"] = 0
        tx["content"] = json.dumps(cobj, ensure_ascii=False)

    # 4. Replace audio material with our 41.50s No-Copyright BGM
    bgm_str = str(bgm_path.resolve()).replace("\\", "/")
    for au in dc["materials"].get("audios", []):
        au["path"] = bgm_str
        au["name"] = bgm_path.name
        au["duration"] = 41500000
    for tr in dc["tracks"]:
        if tr["type"] == "audio":
            for seg in tr["segments"]:
                seg["source_timerange"] = {"start": 0, "duration": seg["target_timerange"]["duration"]}

    dc["id"] = str(uuid.uuid4()).upper()
    dc["canvas_config"] = {"width": 1920, "height": 1080, "ratio": "16:9"}

    # Save to both hermes_cybertruck_longform (stage) and deploy to com.lveditor.draft/hermes_cybertruck_optic_longform
    results = {}
    for draft_name in ("hermes_cybertruck_longform", "hermes_cybertruck_optic_longform"):
        stage_draft_dir = STAGE_DIR / draft_name
        if stage_draft_dir.exists():
            shutil.rmtree(stage_draft_dir)
        stage_draft_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        # Copy template shell metadata structure from 26 폴스타4 옵틱 [26.03.13]
        src_shell_dir = DRAFT_ROOT / "26 폴스타4 옵틱 [26.03.13]"
        dm = json.loads((src_shell_dir / "draft_meta_info.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        dm["draft_id"] = str(uuid.uuid4()).upper()
        dm["draft_name"] = draft_name
        dm["draft_root_path"] = "C:/Users/bssho/AppData/Local/CapCut/User Data/Projects/com.lveditor.draft"
        dm["draft_fold_path"] = f"C:/Users/bssho/AppData/Local/CapCut/User Data/Projects/com.lveditor.draft/{draft_name}"
        dm["tm_duration"] = dc.get("duration", 41500000)

        populate_draft_materials(dc, dm)

        # Also add alternate Phonk BGM to media bin
        now_s = int(time.time())
        now_us = int(time.time() * 1_000_000)
        if alt_bgm_path.exists():
            dm["draft_materials"][0]["value"].append({
                "ai_group_type": "",
                "create_time": now_s,
                "duration": 41500000,
                "enter_from": 0,
                "extra_info": alt_bgm_path.name,
                "file_Path": str(alt_bgm_path.resolve()).replace("\\", "/"),
                "height": 0,
                "id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
                "import_time": now_s,
                "import_time_ms": now_us,
                "item_source": 1,
                "material_color_tag": "",
                "md5": "",
                "metetype": "music",
                "roughcut_time_range": {"duration": 41500000, "start": 0},
                "sub_time_range": {"duration": -1, "start": -1},
                "type": 0,
                "width": 0,
            })

        dc_json = json.dumps(dc, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
        dm_json = json.dumps(dm, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

        # Write both root draft_content.json and Timelines/1D4243F2.../draft_content.json
        (stage_draft_dir / "draft_content.json").write_text(dc_json, encoding="utf-8")
        (stage_draft_dir / "draft_meta_info.json").write_text(dm_json, encoding="utf-8")
        tl_dir = stage_draft_dir / "Timelines" / "1D4243F2-179F-43c2-AC12-977981653637"
        tl_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (tl_dir / "draft_content.json").write_text(dc_json, encoding="utf-8")
        if (src_shell_dir / "draft_agency_config.json").exists():
            shutil.copy2(src_shell_dir / "draft_agency_config.json", stage_draft_dir / "draft_agency_config.json")
        if (src_shell_dir / "draft_biz_config.json").exists():
            shutil.copy2(src_shell_dir / "draft_biz_config.json", stage_draft_dir / "draft_biz_config.json")
        if (src_shell_dir / "timeline_layout.json").exists():
            shutil.copy2(src_shell_dir / "timeline_layout.json", stage_draft_dir / "timeline_layout.json")

        results[draft_name] = {
            "staged_path": str(stage_draft_dir),
            "deployed_path": None,
            "media_bin_count": len(dm["draft_materials"][0]["value"]),
        }

    # Deploy safely if CapCut is not running
    pf = run_preflight(check_snapshot=False)
    if pf["can_write_to_com_lveditor_draft"]:
        for draft_name in ("hermes_cybertruck_optic_longform", "hermes_cybertruck_longform"):
            target_dir = DRAFT_ROOT / draft_name
            # Overwrite only our own hermes_cybertruck_* folder if CapCut is closed
            if target_dir.exists() and draft_name.startswith("hermes_cybertruck_"):
                shutil.rmtree(target_dir)
            if not target_dir.exists():
                shutil.copytree(STAGE_DIR / draft_name, target_dir)
                ok_pt, _ = check_draft_plaintext(target_dir)
                results[draft_name]["deployed_path"] = str(target_dir)
                print(f"[5/5] Deployed authentic Long-Form CapCut draft to {target_dir} (plaintext={ok_pt})")

    return results


def main():
    t0 = time.time()
    prepared_scenes, bgm_path, alt_bgm_path = prepare_longform_media()
    spec_out = write_longform_spec_json(prepared_scenes, bgm_path)
    mp4_out, grid_out = build_filmcraft_longform(prepared_scenes, bgm_path)
    cc_info = build_capcut_longform_from_official_template(prepared_scenes, bgm_path, alt_bgm_path)
    print(f"\n[COMPLETE in {round(time.time() - t0, 1)}s]")
    print("  Long-Form Spec:", spec_out)
    print("  Short-Form Spec:", SHORTFORM_SPECS_DIR / "polestar4_reels.spec.json")
    print("  FilmCraft MP4:", mp4_out)
    print("  Comparison Sheet:", grid_out)
    print("  CapCut Drafts:", json.dumps(cc_info, ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def compose_full_mirror_16x9(src_img: pathlib.Path, out_png: pathlib.Path, fill_mode: str = "studio"):
    """
    Composes a 1920x1080 (16:9) frame for Long-Form template in 100% natural color without ANY Short-Form red/green border boxes,
    black-and-white conversion, or unrelated images, while keeping 100% of the side mirror housing & glass visible.
    """
    im = Image.open(src_img).convert("RGB")

    if fill_mode == "hero_16x9":
        # 1200x600 Cybertruck hero -> fill 1920x1080 using soft blurred ambient extension at top/bottom 60px
        bg = im.resize((1920, 1080), Image.Resampling.BICUBIC).filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius=28))
        bg = ImageEnhance.Brightness(bg).enhance(0.45)
        fg = im.resize((1920, 960), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
        bg.paste(fg, (0, 60))
        bg.save(out_png)
        return

    # Default 'studio' full-mirror composition in 100% natural color (e.g. 광각미러전 테슬라.jpg, 광각미러후 테슬라.jpg)
    bg = im.resize((1920, 1080), Image.Resampling.BICUBIC).filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius=36))
    bg = ImageEnhance.Brightness(bg).enhance(0.35)
    scale = min(1560 / im.width, 940 / im.height)
    nw, nh = int(im.width * scale), int(im.height * scale)
    fg = im.resize((nw, nh), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    bg.paste(fg, ((1920 - nw) // 2, (1080 - nh) // 2))
    bg.save(out_png)


def compose_split_50x50_16x9(left_img: pathlib.Path, right_img: pathlib.Path, out_png: pathlib.Path):
    """
    Creates an authentic OpticGlass Long-Form 50:50 edge-to-edge split screen (1920x1080) in 100% natural color (NO black-and-white):
    - Left half (0..960, 0..1080): 시공 전 (100% of stock mirror visible, natural original color)
    - Right half (960..1920, 0..1080): 시공 후 (100% of OpticGlass wide-angle mirror visible, natural original color)
    - Clean 4px white center divider line at x=960.
    """
    canvas = Image.new("RGB", (1920, 1080), (16, 18, 22))
    im_l = Image.open(left_img).convert("RGB")
    im_r = Image.open(right_img).convert("RGB")

    for side_idx, im in enumerate((im_l, im_r)):
        x_offset = 0 if side_idx == 0 else 960
        # Soft ambient fill for the 960x1080 half
        half_bg = im.resize((960, 1080), Image.Resampling.BICUBIC).filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius=28))
        half_bg = ImageEnhance.Brightness(half_bg).enhance(0.32)
        canvas.paste(half_bg, (x_offset, 0))
        # Fit 100% of the mirror image inside 920x920 centered in the 960x1080 panel
        scale = min(920 / im.width, 920 / im.height)
        nw, nh = int(im.width * scale), int(im.height * scale)
        fg = im.resize((nw, nh), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
        px = x_offset + (960 - nw) // 2
        py = (1080 - nh) // 2
        canvas.paste(fg, (px, py))

    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
    draw.line([(960, 0), (960, 1080)], fill=(255, 255, 255), width=4)
    canvas.save(out_png)


def image_to_mp4(img_path: pathlib.Path, out_mp4: pathlib.Path, dur_s: float, zoom: bool = False):
    frames = max(1, int(round(dur_s * 30)))
    if zoom:
        vf = (
            f"scale=1920:1080:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,"
            f"pad=1920:1080:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:black,"
            f"zoompan=z='min(zoom+0.0007,1.05)':x='iw/2-(iw/zoom/2)':y='ih/2-(ih/zoom/2)':d={frames}:s=1920x1080:fps=30,setsar=1"
        )
        run_ffmpeg([
            "-loop", "1", "-i", str(img_path),
            "-t", f"{dur_s:.3f}",
            "-vf", vf,
            "-c:v", "libx264", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-r", "30",
            str(out_mp4),
        ])
    else:
        vf = "scale=1920:1080:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=1920:1080:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:black,fps=30,setsar=1"
        run_ffmpeg([
            "-loop", "1", "-framerate", "30", "-i", str(img_path),
            "-t", f"{dur_s:.3f}",
            "-vf", vf,
            "-c:v", "libx264", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-r", "30",
            str(out_mp4),
        ])


def trim_video_16x9(src_video: pathlib.Path, out_mp4: pathlib.Path, ss: float, dur_s: float, speed_pts: float = 1.0):
    vf_parts = []
    if abs(speed_pts - 1.0) > 0.01:
        vf_parts.append(f"setpts={speed_pts:.4f}*PTS")
    vf_parts.append("scale=1920:1080:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=1920:1080:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:black,fps=30,setsar=1")
    vf = ",".join(vf_parts)
    run_ffmpeg([
        "-ss", f"{ss:.3f}", "-i", str(src_video),
        "-t", f"{dur_s:.3f}",
        "-vf", vf,
        "-an",
        "-c:v", "libx264", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-r", "30",
        str(out_mp4),
    ])

        # Left half of 사이버트럭 리사.jpg shows the matte-black Cybertruck side profile & triangular mirror
        w, h = im.size
        crop = im.crop((0, int(h * 0.12), int(w * 0.50), int(h * 0.88)))
        bg = crop.resize((1920, 1080), Image.Resampling.BICUBIC).filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius=32))
        bg = ImageEnhance.Brightness(bg).enhance(0.38)
        scale = min(1760 / crop.width, 980 / crop.height)
        nw, nh = int(crop.width * scale), int(crop.height * scale)
        fg = crop.resize((nw, nh), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
        bg.paste(fg, ((1920 - nw) // 2, (1080 - nh) // 2))
        bg.save(out_png)
        return

    # Default 'studio' full-mirror composition (e.g. 광각미러전 테슬라.jpg, 광각미러후 테슬라.jpg)
    bg = im.resize((1920, 1080), Image.Resampling.BICUBIC).filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius=36))
    bg = ImageEnhance.Brightness(bg).enhance(0.35)
    scale = min(1560 / im.width, 940 / im.height)
    nw, nh = int(im.width * scale), int(im.height * scale)
    fg = im.resize((nw, nh), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    bg.paste(fg, ((1920 - nw) // 2, (1080 - nh) // 2))
    bg.save(out_png)


def compose_split_50x50_16x9(left_img: pathlib.Path, right_img: pathlib.Path, out_png: pathlib.Path, left_bw: bool = True):
    """
    Creates an authentic OpticGlass Long-Form 50:50 edge-to-edge split screen (1920x1080):
    - Left half (0..960, 0..1080): 시공 전 (100% of stock mirror visible, desaturated B&W look like tpl1_45s.jpg)
    - Right half (960..1920, 0..1080): 시공 후 (100% of OpticGlass wide-angle mirror visible, vivid color)
    - Clean 4px white center divider line at x=960 (no Short-Form red/green border boxes).
    """
    canvas = Image.new("RGB", (1920, 1080), (16, 18, 22))
    im_l = Image.open(left_img).convert("RGB")
    if left_bw:
        im_l = im_l.convert("L").convert("RGB")
    im_r = Image.open(right_img).convert("RGB")

    for side_idx, im in enumerate((im_l, im_r)):
        x_offset = 0 if side_idx == 0 else 960
        # Soft ambient fill for the 960x1080 half
        half_bg = im.resize((960, 1080), Image.Resampling.BICUBIC).filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius=28))
        half_bg = ImageEnhance.Brightness(half_bg).enhance(0.32)
        canvas.paste(half_bg, (x_offset, 0))
        # Fit 100% of the mirror image inside 920x920 centered in the 960x1080 panel
        scale = min(920 / im.width, 920 / im.height)
        nw, nh = int(im.width * scale), int(im.height * scale)
        fg = im.resize((nw, nh), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
        px = x_offset + (960 - nw) // 2
        py = (1080 - nh) // 2
        canvas.paste(fg, (px, py))

    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
    draw.line([(960, 0), (960, 1080)], fill=(255, 255, 255), width=4)
    canvas.save(out_png)


def image_to_mp4(img_path: pathlib.Path, out_mp4: pathlib.Path, dur_s: float, zoom: bool = False):
    frames = max(1, int(round(dur_s * 30)))
    if zoom:
        vf = (
            f"scale=1920:1080:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,"
            f"pad=1920:1080:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:black,"
            f"zoompan=z='min(zoom+0.0007,1.05)':x='iw/2-(iw/zoom/2)':y='ih/2-(ih/zoom/2)':d={frames}:s=1920x1080:fps=30,setsar=1"
        )
        run_ffmpeg([
            "-loop", "1", "-i", str(img_path),
            "-t", f"{dur_s:.3f}",
            "-vf", vf,
            "-c:v", "libx264", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-r", "30",
            str(out_mp4),
        ])
    else:
        vf = "scale=1920:1080:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=1920:1080:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:black,fps=30,setsar=1"
        run_ffmpeg([
            "-loop", "1", "-framerate", "30", "-i", str(img_path),
            "-t", f"{dur_s:.3f}",
            "-vf", vf,
            "-c:v", "libx264", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-r", "30",
            str(out_mp4),
        ])


def trim_video_16x9(src_video: pathlib.Path, out_mp4: pathlib.Path, ss: float, dur_s: float, speed_pts: float = 1.0):
    vf_parts = []
    if abs(speed_pts - 1.0) > 0.01:
        vf_parts.append(f"setpts={speed_pts:.4f}*PTS")
    vf_parts.append("scale=1920:1080:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=1920:1080:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:black,fps=30,setsar=1")
    vf = ",".join(vf_parts)
    run_ffmpeg([
        "-ss", f"{ss:.3f}", "-i", str(src_video),
        "-t", f"{dur_s:.3f}",
        "-vf", vf,
        "-an",
        "-c:v", "libx264", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-r", "30",
        str(out_mp4),
    ])

    print("[4/5] Compiling authentic CapCut Long-Form draft from template 1D4243F2 (full color, no B&W filter) ...")

    # Collect IDs of color-desaturation / B&W adjustments to strip from video segments
    color_adjust_ids = set()
    for k in ("hsl", "primary_color_wheels"):
        for it in dc["materials"].get(k, []):
            if "id" in it:
                color_adjust_ids.add(it["id"])
    for it in dc["materials"].get("effects", []):
        if it.get("type") in ("saturation", "contrast", "highlight", "shadow", "white", "black", "light_sensation", "brightness"):
            color_adjust_ids.add(it["id"])

    # 2. Map Track 0 (17 main video segments: s00 ~ s16) and Track 7 (1 outro segment: s17)

            "lower_left_x": 0.0, "lower_left_y": 1.0,

        new_videos_list.append(new_vid)

            seg["clip"]["transform"] = {"x": 0.0, "y": 0.0}

    Clones the authentic OpticGlass Long-Form Template (1D4243F2-179F-43c2-AC12-977981653637 from '26 폴스타4 옵틱 [26.03.13]')

    transitions, and animations, while swapping the 18 video slots to our 16:9 Cybertruck & Tesla Wide-Angle Mirror clips.
    """
    print("[4/5] Compiling authentic CapCut Long-Form draft from template 1D4243F2 ...")
    dc = json.loads(TEMPLATE_1D42_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    # 1. Fix any foreign user cache paths (C:/Users/wish/ or C:/Users/정민석/) to C:/Users/bssho/
    dc_str = json.dumps(dc, ensure_ascii=False)
    dc_str = dc_str.replace("C:/Users/wish/", "C:/Users/bssho/").replace("C:/Users/정민석/", "C:/Users/bssho/")
    dc = json.loads(dc_str)

    # 2. Map Track 0 (17 main video segments: s00 ~ s16) and Track 7 (1 outro segment: s17)
    vmap = {v["id"]: v for v in dc["materials"]["videos"]}
    smap = {sp["id"]: sp for sp in dc["materials"].get("speeds", [])}

    # Clear redundant split-screen overlay video tracks (Track 1, 2, 4) because s15 & s16 are pre-composed 50:50 split-screen 16:9 MP4s
    for ti in (1, 2, 4):
        if ti < len(dc["tracks"]) and dc["tracks"][ti]["type"] == "video":
            dc["tracks"][ti]["segments"] = []

    main_v_segs = dc["tracks"][0]["segments"]
    outro_v_segs = dc["tracks"][7]["segments"]
    all_target_segs = main_v_segs + outro_v_segs  # 17 + 1 = 18 segments matching prepared_scenes[0..17]

    new_videos_list = []
    for idx, (seg, sc) in enumerate(zip(all_target_segs, prepared_scenes)):
        old_vid = vmap.get(seg["material_id"], {})
        new_vid = copy.deepcopy(old_vid) if old_vid else {}
        new_mat_id = str(uuid.uuid4()).upper()

        new_vid["width"] = 1920
        new_vid["height"] = 1080
        new_vid["duration"] = dur_us
        new_vid["crop_ratio"] = "free"
        new_vid["crop"] = {

            "upper_right_x": 1.0, "upper_right_y": 0.0,
            "lower_left_x": 0.0, "lower_left_y": 1.0,
            "lower_right_x": 1.0, "lower_right_y": 1.0,
        }
        new_videos_list.append(new_vid)

        seg["material_id"] = new_mat_id
        seg["source_timerange"] = {"start": 0, "duration": dur_us}
        seg["speed"] = 1.0
        if "clip" in seg and isinstance(seg["clip"], dict):
            seg["clip"]["scale"] = {"x": 1.0, "y": 1.0}
            seg["clip"]["transform"] = {"x": 0.0, "y": 0.0}
        # Reset any speed material refs to 1.0x so source_timerange matches 1:1
        for ref_id in seg.get("extra_material_refs", []):
            if ref_id in smap:
                smap[ref_id]["speed"] = 1.0

    dc["materials"]["videos"] = new_videos_list

42: def compose_full_mirror_16x9(src_img: pathlib.Path, out_png: pathlib.Path, fill_mode: str = "studio"):
43:     """
44:     Composes a 1920x1080 (16:9) frame for Long-Form template in 100% natural color without ANY Short-Form red/green border boxes,

51:         bg = im.resize((1920, 1080), Image.Resampling.BICUBIC).filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius=28))
52:         bg = ImageEnhance.Brightness(bg).enhance(0.45)

68: def compose_split_50x50_16x9(left_img: pathlib.Path, right_img: pathlib.Path, out_png: pathlib.Path):
69:     """
70:     Creates an authentic OpticGlass Long-Form 50:50 edge-to-edge split screen (1920x1080) in 100% natural color (NO black-and-white):
71:     - Left half (0..960, 0..1080): 시공 전 (100% of stock mirror visible, natural original color)
72:     - Right half (960..1920, 0..1080): 시공 후 (100% of OpticGlass wide-angle mirror visible, natural original color)
73:     - Clean 4px white center divider line at x=960.
74:     """
75:     canvas = Image.new("RGB", (1920, 1080), (16, 18, 22))
76:     im_l = Image.open(left_img).convert("RGB")
77:     im_r = Image.open(right_img).convert("RGB")
78: 
79:     for side_idx, im in enumerate((im_l, im_r)):
80:         x_offset = 0 if side_idx == 0 else 960
81:         # Soft ambient fill for the 960x1080 half
82:         half_bg = im.resize((960, 1080), Image.Resampling.BICUBIC).filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius=28))
83:         half_bg = ImageEnhance.Brightness(half_bg).enhance(0.32)
84:         canvas.paste(half_bg, (x_offset, 0))
85:         # Fit 100% of the mirror image inside 920x920 centered in the 960x1080 panel
86:         scale = min(920 / im.width, 920 / im.height)
87:         nw, nh = int(im.width * scale), int(im.height * scale)
88:         fg = im.resize((nw, nh), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
89:         px = x_offset + (960 - nw) // 2
90:         py = (1080 - nh) // 2
91:         canvas.paste(fg, (px, py))
92: 
93:     draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
94:     draw.line([(960, 0), (960, 1080)], fill=(255, 255, 255), width=4)
95:     canvas.save(out_png)

def brighten_exposure_pil(im: Image.Image, gamma: float = 0.72, brightness: float = 1.16, saturation: float = 1.08) -> Image.Image:
    """
    Applies a smooth shadow/midtone-lifting gamma curve + brightness boost so dark car interiors
    and side mirror housings have bright, clear exposure without clipping highlights.
    """
    lut = [min(255, int(round(255.0 * ((i / 255.0) ** gamma)))) for i in range(256)]
    out = im.point(lut * 3)
    out = ImageEnhance.Brightness(out).enhance(brightness)
    out = ImageEnhance.Color(out).enhance(saturation)
    return out


def compose_full_mirror_16x9(src_img: pathlib.Path, out_png: pathlib.Path, fill_mode: str = "studio"):
    """
    Composes a 1920x1080 (16:9) frame for Long-Form template in 100% natural color with bright exposure,
    without ANY Short-Form red/green border boxes, black-and-white conversion, or unrelated images,
    while keeping 100% of the side mirror housing & glass visible.
    """
    im = brighten_exposure_pil(Image.open(src_img).convert("RGB"))

    if fill_mode == "hero_16x9":
        # 1200x600 Cybertruck hero -> fill 1920x1080 using bright soft blurred ambient extension at top/bottom 60px
        bg = im.resize((1920, 1080), Image.Resampling.BICUBIC).filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius=28))
        bg = ImageEnhance.Brightness(bg).enhance(0.88)
        fg = im.resize((1920, 960), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
        bg.paste(fg, (0, 60))
        bg.save(out_png)
        return

    # Default 'studio' full-mirror composition in 100% natural color with bright exposure
    bg = im.resize((1920, 1080), Image.Resampling.BICUBIC).filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius=36))
    bg = ImageEnhance.Brightness(bg).enhance(0.85)
    scale = min(1560 / im.width, 940 / im.height)
    nw, nh = int(im.width * scale), int(im.height * scale)
    fg = im.resize((nw, nh), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    bg.paste(fg, ((1920 - nw) // 2, (1080 - nh) // 2))
    bg.save(out_png)


def compose_split_50x50_16x9(left_img: pathlib.Path, right_img: pathlib.Path, out_png: pathlib.Path):
    """
    Creates an authentic OpticGlass Long-Form 50:50 edge-to-edge split screen (1920x1080) in 100% natural color
    with bright exposure (NO black-and-white):
    - Left half (0..960, 0..1080): 시공 전 (100% of stock mirror visible, bright natural color)
    - Right half (960..1920, 0..1080): 시공 후 (100% of OpticGlass wide-angle mirror visible, bright natural color)
    - Clean 4px white center divider line at x=960.
    """
    canvas = Image.new("RGB", (1920, 1080), (36, 40, 48))
    im_l = brighten_exposure_pil(Image.open(left_img).convert("RGB"))
    im_r = brighten_exposure_pil(Image.open(right_img).convert("RGB"))

        x_offset = 0 if side_idx == 0 else 960
        # Bright soft ambient fill for the 960x1080 half

        half_bg = ImageEnhance.Brightness(half_bg).enhance(0.85)
        canvas.paste(half_bg, (x_offset, 0))

def image_to_mp4(img_path: pathlib.Path, out_mp4: pathlib.Path, dur_s: float, zoom: bool = False, brighten: bool = False):

    eq_f = ",eq=brightness=0.07:gamma=1.25:saturation=1.08" if brighten else ""

def trim_video_16x9(src_video: pathlib.Path, out_mp4: pathlib.Path, ss: float, dur_s: float, speed_pts: float = 1.0, brighten: bool = True):
    vf_parts = []
    if abs(speed_pts - 1.0) > 0.01:
        vf_parts.append(f"setpts={speed_pts:.4f}*PTS")
    vf_parts.append("scale=1920:1080:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=1920:1080:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:black,fps=30,setsar=1")

        "-t", f"{dur_s:.3f}",
        "-vf", vf,
        "-an",
        "-c:v", "libx264", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-r", "30",

        x_offset = 0 if side_idx == 0 else 960
        # Soft ambient fill for the 960x1080 half
        half_bg = im.resize((960, 1080), Image.Resampling.BICUBIC).filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius=28))
        half_bg = ImageEnhance.Brightness(half_bg).enhance(0.32)
        canvas.paste(half_bg, (x_offset, 0))
        # Fit 100% of the mirror image inside 920x920 centered in the 960x1080 panel
        scale = min(920 / im.width, 920 / im.height)
        nw, nh = int(im.width * scale), int(im.height * scale)
        fg = im.resize((nw, nh), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
        px = x_offset + (960 - nw) // 2
        py = (1080 - nh) // 2
        canvas.paste(fg, (px, py))

    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
    draw.line([(960, 0), (960, 1080)], fill=(255, 255, 255), width=4)
    canvas.save(out_png)


def image_to_mp4(img_path: pathlib.Path, out_mp4: pathlib.Path, dur_s: float, zoom: bool = False):
    frames = max(1, int(round(dur_s * 30)))
    if zoom:
        vf = (
            f"scale=1920:1080:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,"
            f"pad=1920:1080:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:black,"
            f"zoompan=z='min(zoom+0.0007,1.05)':x='iw/2-(iw/zoom/2)':y='ih/2-(ih/zoom/2)':d={frames}:s=1920x1080:fps=30,setsar=1"
        )
        run_ffmpeg([
            "-loop", "1", "-i", str(img_path),
            "-t", f"{dur_s:.3f}",
            "-vf", vf,
            "-c:v", "libx264", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-r", "30",
            str(out_mp4),
        ])
    else:
        vf = "scale=1920:1080:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=1920:1080:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:black,fps=30,setsar=1"
        run_ffmpeg([
            "-loop", "1", "-framerate", "30", "-i", str(img_path),
            "-t", f"{dur_s:.3f}",
            "-vf", vf,
            "-c:v", "libx264", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-r", "30",
            str(out_mp4),
        ])


def trim_video_16x9(src_video: pathlib.Path, out_mp4: pathlib.Path, ss: float, dur_s: float, speed_pts: float = 1.0):
    vf_parts = []
    if abs(speed_pts - 1.0) > 0.01:
        vf_parts.append(f"setpts={speed_pts:.4f}*PTS")
    vf_parts.append("scale=1920:1080:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=1920:1080:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:black,fps=30,setsar=1")
    vf = ",".join(vf_parts)
    run_ffmpeg([
        "-ss", f"{ss:.3f}", "-i", str(src_video),
        "-t", f"{dur_s:.3f}",
        "-vf", vf,
        "-an",
        "-c:v", "libx264", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-r", "30",
        str(out_mp4),
    ])

import subprocess
import pathlib
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

dl = pathlib.Path(r"C:\Users\bssho\Downloads")
scratch = pathlib.Path(r"C:\Users\bssho\.gemini\antigravity\brain\742a7a43-c9e1-47cb-8b9e-4ffb239a3bd7\scratch")

movs = ["엔딩영상.MOV", "미러.MOV", "미러2.MOV", "교체.MOV"]
for m in movs:
    p = dl / m
    if not p.exists():
        print("Missing:", p)
        continue
    # get duration
    r = subprocess.run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration", "-of", "default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1", str(p)], capture_output=True, text=True)
    dur = float(r.stdout.strip())
    print(f"{m}: {dur:.2f}s")
    # sample 8 frames across duration
    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (1600, 480), (20, 20, 20))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    for i in range(8):
        t = min(dur - 0.1, (dur / 8.0) * i + 0.2)
        out_f = scratch / f"{p.stem}_{i}.jpg"
        subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-ss", f"{t:.2f}", "-i", str(p), "-frames:v", "1", "-vf", "scale=380:214", str(out_f)], check=True)
        im = Image.open(out_f)
        r_idx, c_idx = divmod(i, 4)
        x0 = 10 + c_idx * 395
        y0 = 10 + r_idx * 235
        sheet.paste(im, (x0, y0 + 18))
        draw.text((x0 + 5, y0 + 2), f"{p.name} @ {t:.1f}s", fill=(255, 255, 0))
    sheet.save(scratch / f"sheet_{p.stem}.jpg")

import pathlib
import subprocess
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

dl = pathlib.Path(r"C:\Users\bssho\Downloads")
scratch = pathlib.Path(r"C:\Users\bssho\.gemini\antigravity\brain\742a7a43-c9e1-47cb-8b9e-4ffb239a3bd7\scratch")

candidates = [
    "사이버트럭사진.jpg",
    "광각미러전 테슬라.jpg",
    "광각미러후 테슬라.jpg",
    "테슬라 전.jpg",
    "테슬라 후.jpg",
    "테슬라 광각미러전.JPG",
    "테슬라 광각미러 후.JPG",
    "교체전.JPG",
    "교체후.JPG",
    "영상_테슬라.png",
    "테슬람 미러.png",
    "테슬라 마지막전.jpg",
    "테슬라 마지막.jpg",
    "테슬라.jpg",
    "테슬라12.jpg",
    "테슬라4.png",
    "테슬라다시.jpg",
    r"20260923\옵틱글래스 상세페이지\조견표\테슬라\5010_테슬라 사이버트럭.jpg",
    r"20260923\옵틱글래스 상세페이지\조견표\기타\OPTICGLASS_테슬라_운전석.jpg",
]

sheet = Image.new("RGB", (1600, 1200), (20, 20, 20))
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
for idx, rel in enumerate(candidates):
    p = dl / rel
    if not p.exists():
        print("Missing:", p)
        continue
    im = Image.open(p).convert("RGB")
    w, h = im.size
    im.thumbnail((370, 210))
    r, c = divmod(idx, 4)
    x0 = 15 + c * 395
    y0 = 15 + r * 235
    sheet.paste(im, (x0, y0 + 20))
    draw.text((x0 + 4, y0 + 2), f"[{idx}] {p.name} ({w}x{h})", fill=(255, 255, 0))

sheet.save(scratch / "tesla_imgs_sheet.jpg")

# Also sample 테슬라 미러비교.MOV and 교체2.MOV
for mov_name in ["테슬라 미러비교.MOV", "교체2.MOV"]:
    mp = dl / mov_name
    if not mp.exists():
        continue
    r = subprocess.run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration", "-of", "default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1", str(mp)], capture_output=True, text=True)
    dur = float(r.stdout.strip())
    print(f"{mov_name}: {dur:.2f}s")
    msheet = Image.new("RGB", (1600, 480), (20, 20, 20))
    mdraw = ImageDraw.Draw(msheet)
    for i in range(8):
        t = min(dur - 0.1, (dur / 8.0) * i + 0.2)
        out_f = scratch / f"{mp.stem}_{i}.jpg"
        subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-ss", f"{t:.2f}", "-i", str(mp), "-frames:v", "1", "-vf", "scale=380:214:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=380:214:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:black", str(out_f)], check=True)
        im = Image.open(out_f)
        r_idx, c_idx = divmod(i, 4)
        x0 = 10 + c_idx * 395
        y0 = 10 + r_idx * 235
        msheet.paste(im, (x0, y0 + 18))
        mdraw.text((x0 + 5, y0 + 2), f"{mp.name} @ {t:.1f}s", fill=(255, 255, 0))
    msheet.save(scratch / f"sheet_{mp.stem}.jpg")

import subprocess
import pathlib
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

dl = pathlib.Path(r"C:\Users\bssho\Downloads")
scratch = pathlib.Path(r"C:\Users\bssho\.gemini\antigravity\brain\742a7a43-c9e1-47cb-8b9e-4ffb239a3bd7\scratch")

# Test 16:9 horizontal crop from 1080x1920 Tesla videos:
# In 테슬라 미러비교.MOV (1080x1920), let's test y-offsets 520, 580, 640 for 1080x608 crop
tests = [
    ("테슬라 미러비교.MOV", 1.5, 560, "test_comp_15.jpg"),
    ("테슬라 미러비교.MOV", 6.5, 560, "test_comp_65.jpg"),
    ("교체2.MOV", 4.5, 580, "test_inst_45.jpg"),
]

imgs = []
for fn, ss, yoff, out_name in tests:
    out_p = scratch / out_name
    vf = f"crop=1080:608:0:{yoff},scale=1920:1080,eq=brightness=0.07:gamma=1.24:saturation=1.08"
    subprocess.run([
        "ffmpeg", "-y", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error",
        "-ss", str(ss), "-i", str(dl / fn),
        "-frames:v", "1", "-vf", vf, str(out_p)
    ], check=True)
    imgs.append((out_p, f"{fn} @{ss}s (y={yoff})"))

sheet = Image.new("RGB", (1920, 360), (20, 20, 20))
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
for idx, (p, lbl) in enumerate(imgs):
    im = Image.open(p).resize((620, 348))
    sheet.paste(im, (10 + idx * 635, 6))
    draw.text((20 + idx * 635, 14), lbl, fill=(255, 230, 80))
sheet.save(scratch / "test_16x9_crops.jpg")
print("Saved test_16x9_crops.jpg")

def compose_full_mirror_16x9(src_img: pathlib.Path, out_png: pathlib.Path, fill_mode: str = "studio"):
    """
    Composes a 1920x1080 (16:9) frame for Long-Form template in 100% natural color with bright exposure,
    without ANY Short-Form red/green border boxes, black-and-white conversion, or unrelated images,
    while keeping 100% of the side mirror housing & glass visible.
    """
    raw_im = Image.open(src_img).convert("RGB")

    if fill_mode == "road_16x9":
        # 941x1672 Tesla side mirror on multi-lane highway -> 16:9 crop (941x529) around full side mirror housing
        cropped = raw_im.crop((0, 535, 941, 535 + 529)).resize((1920, 1080), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
        out = brighten_exposure_pil(cropped, gamma=0.72, brightness=1.15, saturation=1.08)
        out.save(out_png)
        return

    if fill_mode == "park_16x9":
        # 800x800 Tesla side mirror in parking garage -> 16:9 crop (800x450) around full side mirror housing
        cropped = raw_im.crop((0, 195, 800, 195 + 450)).resize((1920, 1080), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
        out = brighten_exposure_pil(cropped, gamma=0.74, brightness=1.12, saturation=1.06)
        out.save(out_png)
        return

    if fill_mode == "spec_card":
        # 960x600 official OpticGlass No.5010 Tesla Cybertruck compatibility card -> clean 16:9 fit
        bg = Image.new("RGB", (1920, 1080), (27, 27, 27))
        fg = raw_im.resize((1728, 1080), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
        bg.paste(fg, ((1920 - 1728) // 2, 0))
        bg.save(out_png)
        return

    im = brighten_exposure_pil(raw_im)

    if fill_mode == "hero_16x9":
        # 1200x600 Cybertruck hero -> fill 1920x1080 using bright soft blurred ambient extension at top/bottom 60px
        bg = im.resize((1920, 1080), Image.Resampling.BICUBIC).filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius=28))
        bg = ImageEnhance.Brightness(bg).enhance(0.88)
        fg = im.resize((1920, 960), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
        bg.paste(fg, (0, 60))
        bg.save(out_png)
        return

    # Default 'studio' full-mirror composition in 100% natural color with bright exposure
    bg = im.resize((1920, 1080), Image.Resampling.BICUBIC).filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius=36))
    bg = ImageEnhance.Brightness(bg).enhance(0.85)
    scale = min(1560 / im.width, 940 / im.height)
    nw, nh = int(im.width * scale), int(im.height * scale)
    fg = im.resize((nw, nh), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    bg.paste(fg, ((1920 - nw) // 2, (1080 - nh) // 2))
    bg.save(out_png)

140: def image_to_mp4(img_path: pathlib.Path, out_mp4: pathlib.Path, dur_s: float, zoom: bool = False, brighten: bool = False):
141:     frames = max(1, int(round(dur_s * 30)))
142:     eq_f = ",eq=brightness=0.07:gamma=1.25:saturation=1.08" if brighten else ""
143:     if zoom:
144:         vf = (
145:             f"scale=1920:1080:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,"
146:             f"pad=1920:1080:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:black,"
147:             f"zoompan=z='min(zoom+0.0007,1.05)':x='iw/2-(iw/zoom/2)':y='ih/2-(ih/zoom/2)':d={frames}:s=1920x1080:fps=30,setsar=1{eq_f}"
148:         )
149:         run_ffmpeg([
150:             "-loop", "1", "-i", str(img_path),
151:             "-t", f"{dur_s:.3f}",
152:             "-vf", vf,
153:             "-c:v", "libx264", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-r", "30",
154:             str(out_mp4),
155:         ])
156:     else:
157:         vf = f"scale=1920:1080:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=1920:1080:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:black,fps=30,setsar=1{eq_f}"
158:         run_ffmpeg([
159:             "-loop", "1", "-framerate", "30", "-i", str(img_path),
160:             "-t", f"{dur_s:.3f}",
161:             "-vf", vf,
162:             "-c:v", "libx264", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-r", "30",

167: def trim_video_16x9(src_video: pathlib.Path, out_mp4: pathlib.Path, ss: float, dur_s: float, speed_pts: float = 1.0, brighten: bool = True):
168:     vf_parts = []

179:         "-an",

42:         h = "".join(c * 2 for c in h)
43:     return int(h[0:2], 16), int(h[2:4], 16), int(h[4:6], 16)

46: def resize_cover(im: Image.Image, target_w: int, target_h: int, align_x: float = 0.5, align_y: float = 0.5) -> Image.Image:
47:     im = im.convert("RGB")
48:     scale = max(target_w / im.width, target_h / im.height)
49:     nw, nh = max(1, int(round(im.width * scale))), max(1, int(round(im.height * scale)))
50:     resized = im.resize((nw, nh), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
51:     left = int(round((nw - target_w) * align_x))
52:     top = int(round((nh - target_h) * align_y))
53:     return resized.crop((left, top, left + target_w, top + target_h))

56: def render_slanted_gradient_text(
57:     text: str,
58:     font_size: int,
59:     top_color: Tuple[int, int, int],
60:     bottom_color: Tuple[int, int, int],
61:     stroke_width: int = 8,
62:     stroke_color: Tuple[int, int, int] = (0, 0, 0),
63:     shear: float = 0.16,
64:     shadow_offset: Tuple[int, int] = (4, 6),
65: ) -> Image.Image:
66:     """
67:     Renders crisp Korean display typography (zero blur):
68:     - Vertical metallic/gold gradient fill
69:     - Thick black outer stroke
70:     - Crisp hard drop shadow (no GaussianBlur)
71:     - Slight italic/forward slant (affine shear)
72:     """
73:     font = get_font(font_size, display=True)
74:     dummy = Image.new("RGBA", (10, 10), (0, 0, 0, 0))
75:     d_dummy = ImageDraw.Draw(dummy)
76:     bbox = d_dummy.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font, stroke_width=stroke_width)
77:     tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
78:     th = bbox[3] - bbox[1]
79:     pad = stroke_width * 2 + 20
80:     w, h = tw + pad * 2, th + pad * 2
81: 
82:     txt_mask = Image.new("L", (w, h), 0)
83:     d_mask = ImageDraw.Draw(txt_mask)
84:     ox, oy = pad - bbox[0], pad - bbox[1]
85:     d_mask.text((ox, oy), text, font=font, fill=255)
86: 
87:     grad = Image.new("RGBA", (w, h), (0, 0, 0, 0))
88:     d_grad = ImageDraw.Draw(grad)
89:     y_top = pad
90:     y_bot = pad + th
91:     span = max(1, y_bot - y_top)
92:     for y in range(h):
93:         t = min(1.0, max(0.0, (y - y_top) / span))
94:         r = int(top_color[0] * (1 - t) + bottom_color[0] * t)
95:         g = int(top_color[1] * (1 - t) + bottom_color[1] * t)
96:         b = int(top_color[2] * (1 - t) + bottom_color[2] * t)
97:         d_grad.line([(0, y), (w, y)], fill=(r, g, b, 255))
98: 
99:     filled_txt = Image.new("RGBA", (w, h), (0, 0, 0, 0))
100:     filled_txt.paste(grad, (0, 0), mask=txt_mask)
101: 
102:     st_layer = Image.new("RGBA", (w, h), (0, 0, 0, 0))
103:     d_st = ImageDraw.Draw(st_layer)
104:     d_st.text(
105:         (ox, oy),
106:         text,
107:         font=font,
108:         fill=(*stroke_color, 255),
109:         stroke_width=stroke_width,
110:         stroke_fill=(*stroke_color, 255),
111:     )
112: 
113:     base_layer = Image.new("RGBA", (w, h), (0, 0, 0, 0))
114:     sh_layer = Image.new("RGBA", (w, h), (0, 0, 0, 0))
115:     d_sh = ImageDraw.Draw(sh_layer)
116:     d_sh.text(
117:         (ox + shadow_offset[0], oy + shadow_offset[1]),
118:         text,
119:         font=font,
120:         fill=(0, 0, 0, 230),
121:         stroke_width=stroke_width + 2,
122:         stroke_fill=(0, 0, 0, 230),
123:     )
124:     base_layer = Image.alpha_composite(base_layer, sh_layer)
125:     base_layer = Image.alpha_composite(base_layer, st_layer)
126:     base_layer = Image.alpha_composite(base_layer, filled_txt)
127: 
128:     if abs(shear) > 0.001:
129:         extra_w = int(abs(shear) * h) + 12
130:         transform_args = (
131:             (w + extra_w, h),
132:             Image.Transform.AFFINE,
133:             (1.0, shear, -shear * h * 0.65, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0),
134:         )
135:         sheared = base_layer.transform(*transform_args, resample=Image.Resampling.BICUBIC)
136:         sheared_st = st_layer.transform(*transform_args, resample=Image.Resampling.NEAREST)
137:     else:
138:         sheared = base_layer
139:         sheared_st = st_layer
140: 
141:     core_bbox = sheared_st.getbbox()
142:     if core_bbox:
143:         cx0 = max(0, core_bbox[0] - 6)
144:         cy0 = max(0, core_bbox[1] - 4)
145:         cx1 = min(sheared.width, core_bbox[2] + 10)
146:         cy1 = min(sheared.height, core_bbox[3] + 8)
147:         sheared = sheared.crop((cx0, cy0, cx1, cy1))
148:     return sheared
149:

201: def draw_opticglass_logo(
202:     canvas: Image.Image,
203:     x: int,
204:     y: int,
205:     logo_height: int = 40,
206:     with_pill: bool = False,
207: ):
208:     """
209:     Composites the official transparent PNG logo (`옵틱글래스 로고.png`), which contains
210:     both the orange-red crescent+dot symbol and the white 'Optic-Glass' wordmark.
211:     Follows the `수정_*.jpg` template: bare logo without pill box (`with_pill=False`).
212:     """
213:     logo_candidates = [
214:         THUMBNAIL_ROOT_DIR / "옵틱글래스 로고.png",
215:         TEMPLATE_DIR / "옵틱글래스 로고.png",
216:     ]
217:     logo_im: Optional[Image.Image] = None
218:     for cand in logo_candidates:
219:         if cand.exists():
220:             raw_logo = Image.open(cand).convert("RGBA")
221:             bbox = raw_logo.getbbox()
222:             if bbox:
223:                 raw_logo = raw_logo.crop(bbox)
224:             scale = logo_height / max(1, raw_logo.height)
225:             target_w = max(1, int(round(raw_logo.width * scale)))
226:             logo_im = raw_logo.resize((target_w, logo_height), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
227:             break
228: 
229:     overlay = Image.new("RGBA", canvas.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
230:     draw = ImageDraw.Draw(overlay)
231: 
232:     logo_w = logo_im.width if logo_im else 180
233:     if with_pill:
234:         draw.rounded_rectangle(
235:             [x - 14, y - 9, x + logo_w + 14, y + logo_height + 9],
236:             radius=12,
237:             fill=(10, 14, 20, 238),
238:             outline=(90, 105, 125, 200),
239:             width=2,
240:         )
241: 
242:     if logo_im is not None:
243:         alpha = logo_im.getchannel("A")
244:         shadow = Image.new("RGBA", logo_im.size, (0, 0, 0, 235))
245:         shadow.putalpha(alpha)
246:         overlay.alpha_composite(shadow, (x + 2, y + 2))
247:         overlay.alpha_composite(logo_im, (x, y))
248: 
249:     canvas.alpha_composite(overlay)

419: def clean_reference_and_place_logo(ref_id: str, entry: Dict[str, Any]) -> Image.Image:
420:     """
421:     Loads the `수정` template for `ref_id` (from `원본 이미지와 수정 이미지 비교` when available),
422:     and removes any remaining tooltip text (`사각지대 감소! 더 넓게, 더 안전하게!` in 0031,
423:     `시야가 넓어져 사각지대 감소!` in 0034) plus de-blurs 0043's `시공 전` mirror glass.
424:     """
425:     mod_path = MODIFIED_TEMPLATE_MAP.get(ref_id)
426:     if mod_path and mod_path.exists():
427:         im = Image.open(mod_path).convert("RGB")
428:         if im.size != (1280, 720):
429:             im = im.resize((1280, 720), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
430:         arr = np.array(im, dtype=np.float32)
431: 
432:         if ref_id == "0031":
433:             # Remove bottom-right tooltip text "사각지대 감소! 더 넓게, 더 안전하게!" (y=586..720, x=520..1280)
434:             h_slog, w_slog = 720 - 586, 1280 - 520
435:             asphalt_clean = arr[606:660, 140:245]  # Pure wet asphalt reflection
436:             asphalt_tall = np.array(
437:                 Image.fromarray(np.clip(asphalt_clean, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)).resize((220, h_slog), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS),
438:                 dtype=np.float32,
439:             )
440:             asphalt_wide = np.concatenate(
441:                 [asphalt_tall, asphalt_tall[:, ::-1, :], asphalt_tall, asphalt_tall[:, ::-1, :]], axis=1
442:             )[:, :w_slog, :]
443:             for ry in range(h_slog):
444:                 asphalt_wide[ry, :, :] *= (0.82 - 0.15 * (ry / float(h_slog - 1)))
445:             for rx in range(w_slog):
446:                 asphalt_wide[:, rx, :] *= (0.92 - 0.38 * (rx / float(w_slog - 1)))
447:             for ry in range(h_slog):

109: def compose_split_50x50_16x9(left_img: pathlib.Path, right_img: pathlib.Path, out_png: pathlib.Path):
110:     """
111:     Creates an authentic OpticGlass Long-Form 50:50 edge-to-edge split screen (1920x1080) in 100% natural color
112:     with bright exposure (NO black-and-white):
113:     - Left half (0..960, 0..1080): 시공 전 (100% of stock mirror visible, bright natural color)
114:     - Right half (960..1920, 0..1080): 시공 후 (100% of OpticGlass wide-angle mirror visible, bright natural color)
115:     - Clean 4px white center divider line at x=960.
116:     """
117:     canvas = Image.new("RGB", (1920, 1080), (36, 40, 48))
118:     im_l = brighten_exposure_pil(Image.open(left_img).convert("RGB"))
119:     im_r = brighten_exposure_pil(Image.open(right_img).convert("RGB"))
120: 
121:     for side_idx, im in enumerate((im_l, im_r)):
122:         x_offset = 0 if side_idx == 0 else 960
123:         # Bright soft ambient fill for the 960x1080 half
124:         half_bg = im.resize((960, 1080), Image.Resampling.BICUBIC).filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius=28))
125:         half_bg = ImageEnhance.Brightness(half_bg).enhance(0.85)
126:         canvas.paste(half_bg, (x_offset, 0))
127:         # Fit 100% of the mirror image inside 920x920 centered in the 960x1080 panel
128:         scale = min(920 / im.width, 920 / im.height)
129:         nw, nh = int(im.width * scale), int(im.height * scale)
130:         fg = im.resize((nw, nh), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
131:         px = x_offset + (960 - nw) // 2
132:         py = (1080 - nh) // 2
133:         canvas.paste(fg, (px, py))
134: 
135:     draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
136:     draw.line([(960, 0), (960, 1080)], fill=(255, 255, 255), width=4)
137:     canvas.save(out_png)

140: def image_to_mp4(img_path: pathlib.Path, out_mp4: pathlib.Path, dur_s: float, zoom: bool = False, brighten: bool = False):
141:     frames = max(1, int(round(dur_s * 30)))
142:     eq_f = ",eq=brightness=0.07:gamma=1.25:saturation=1.08" if brighten else ""
143:     if zoom:
144:         vf = (
145:             f"scale=1920:1080:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,"
146:             f"pad=1920:1080:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:black,"
147:             f"zoompan=z='min(zoom+0.0007,1.05)':x='iw/2-(iw/zoom/2)':y='ih/2-(ih/zoom/2)':d={frames}:s=1920x1080:fps=30,setsar=1{eq_f}"
148:         )
149:         run_ffmpeg([
150:             "-loop", "1", "-i", str(img_path),
151:             "-t", f"{dur_s:.3f}",
152:             "-vf", vf,
153:             "-c:v", "libx264", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-r", "30",
154:             str(out_mp4),
155:         ])
156:     else:
157:         vf = f"scale=1920:1080:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=1920:1080:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:black,fps=30,setsar=1{eq_f}"
158:         run_ffmpeg([
159:             "-loop", "1", "-framerate", "30", "-i", str(img_path),
160:             "-t", f"{dur_s:.3f}",
161:             "-vf", vf,
162:             "-c:v", "libx264", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-r", "30",
163:             str(out_mp4),

167: def trim_video_16x9(src_video: pathlib.Path, out_mp4: pathlib.Path, ss: float, dur_s: float, speed_pts: float = 1.0, brighten: bool = True):
168:     vf_parts = []

171:     vf_parts.append("scale=1920:1080:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=1920:1080:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:black,fps=30,setsar=1")
172:     if brighten:

175:     run_ffmpeg([
176:         "-ss", f"{ss:.3f}", "-i", str(src_video),
177:         "-t", f"{dur_s:.3f}",
178:         "-vf", vf,
179:         "-an",
180:         "-c:v", "libx264", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-r", "30",
181:         str(out_mp4),

ct_dir = pathlib.Path(r'C:\Users\bssho\Downloads\paperclip-master\video-automation\work\media\cybertruck')

vids = [
    ('테슬라 미러비교.MOV', dl / '테슬라 미러비교.MOV', [0.5, 2.5, 5.0, 8.0]),
    ('사이드미러비교.mp4', dl / '사이드미러비교.mp4', [0.5, 2.0, 4.0, 6.0]),
    ('lf_s01_cybertruck_workshop.mp4', ct_dir / 'lf_s01_cybertruck_workshop.mp4', [0.2, 1.0]),
    ('교체.MOV', dl / '교체.MOV', [1.0, 4.0, 8.0]),
    ('교체2.MOV', dl / '교체2.MOV', [1.0, 3.0, 6.0]),
]

thumbs = []
for name, p, times in vids:
    if not p.exists(): continue
    for t in times:
        out_f = scratch / f'tmp_{name}_{t}.jpg'
        subprocess.run(['ffmpeg', '-y', '-hide_banner', '-loglevel', 'error', '-ss', str(t), '-i', str(p), '-frames:v', '1', str(out_f)])
        if out_f.exists():
            thumbs.append((f'{name} @{t}s', Image.open(out_f).convert('RGB')))

imgs = [
    ('테슬라 광각미러전.JPG', dl / '테슬라 광각미러전.JPG'),
    ('테슬라 광각미러 후.JPG', dl / '테슬라 광각미러 후.JPG'),
    ('테슬라 전.jpg', dl / '테슬라 전.jpg'),

    ('비교샷.png', dl / '비교샷.png'),
]
for name, p in imgs:
    if p.exists():
        thumbs.append((name, Image.open(p).convert('RGB')))

cols = 4
rows = (len(thumbs) + cols - 1) // cols
sheet = Image.new('RGB', (cols * 400, rows * 260), (20, 20, 20))
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
for idx, (lbl, im) in enumerate(thumbs):
    r, c = divmod(idx, cols)
    im_r = im.resize((380, 214))
    sheet.paste(im_r, (c * 400 + 10, r * 260 + 36))
    draw.text((c * 400 + 14, r * 260 + 10), lbl, fill=(255, 230, 80))
sheet.save(scratch / 'media_inspect.png')
print('Saved media_inspect.png with', len(thumbs), 'items')

    """
    Composites the official transparent PNG logo (`옵틱글래스 로고.png`), which contains
    both the orange-red crescent+dot symbol and the white 'Optic-Glass' wordmark.
    Follows Guideline #2: NEVER place a solid background box behind the logo;
    instead apply a subtle Gaussian-blurred drop shadow to separate it cleanly from the background.
    """
    logo_candidates = [
        THUMBNAIL_ROOT_DIR / "옵틱글래스 로고.png",
        TEMPLATE_DIR / "옵틱글래스 로고.png",
    ]
    logo_im: Optional[Image.Image] = None
    for cand in logo_candidates:
        if cand.exists():
            raw_logo = Image.open(cand).convert("RGBA")
            bbox = raw_logo.getbbox()
            if bbox:
                raw_logo = raw_logo.crop(bbox)
            scale = logo_height / max(1, raw_logo.height)
            target_w = max(1, int(round(raw_logo.width * scale)))
            logo_im = raw_logo.resize((target_w, logo_height), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
            break

    overlay = Image.new("RGBA", canvas.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))

    if logo_im is not None:
        alpha = logo_im.getchannel("A")
        # Soft blurred drop shadow + subtle crisp contact shadow (no solid box)
        soft_shadow = Image.new("RGBA", (logo_im.width + 16, logo_im.height + 16), (0, 0, 0, 0))
        sh_mask = Image.new("L", (logo_im.width + 16, logo_im.height + 16), 0)
        sh_mask.paste(alpha, (8, 8))

        soft_shadow_fill = Image.new("RGBA", soft_shadow.size, (0, 0, 0, 210))
        soft_shadow.paste(soft_shadow_fill, (0, 0), mask=sh_mask)
        overlay.alpha_composite(soft_shadow, (max(0, x - 5), max(0, y - 4)))

        contact_shadow = Image.new("RGBA", logo_im.size, (0, 0, 0, 190))
        contact_shadow.putalpha(alpha)
        overlay.alpha_composite(contact_shadow, (x + 2, y + 2))

def draw_opticglass_logo(
    canvas: Image.Image,
    x: int,
    y: int,
    logo_height: int = 40,
    with_pill: bool = False,
):
    """
    Composites the official transparent PNG logo (`옵틱글래스 로고.png`), which contains
    both the orange-red crescent+dot symbol and the white 'Optic-Glass' wordmark.
    Follows the `수정_*.jpg` template: bare logo without pill box (`with_pill=False`).
    """
    logo_candidates = [
        THUMBNAIL_ROOT_DIR / "옵틱글래스 로고.png",
        TEMPLATE_DIR / "옵틱글래스 로고.png",
    ]
    logo_im: Optional[Image.Image] = None
    for cand in logo_candidates:
        if cand.exists():
            raw_logo = Image.open(cand).convert("RGBA")
            bbox = raw_logo.getbbox()
            if bbox:
                raw_logo = raw_logo.crop(bbox)
            scale = logo_height / max(1, raw_logo.height)
            target_w = max(1, int(round(raw_logo.width * scale)))
            logo_im = raw_logo.resize((target_w, logo_height), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
            break

    overlay = Image.new("RGBA", canvas.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(overlay)

    logo_w = logo_im.width if logo_im else 180
    if with_pill:
        draw.rounded_rectangle(
            [x - 14, y - 9, x + logo_w + 14, y + logo_height + 9],
            radius=12,
            fill=(10, 14, 20, 238),
            outline=(90, 105, 125, 200),
            width=2,
        )

    if logo_im is not None:
        alpha = logo_im.getchannel("A")
        shadow = Image.new("RGBA", logo_im.size, (0, 0, 0, 235))
        shadow.putalpha(alpha)
        overlay.alpha_composite(shadow, (x + 2, y + 2))
        overlay.alpha_composite(logo_im, (x, y))

    canvas.alpha_composite(overlay)

def draw_after_emphasis_pil(
    canvas: Image.Image,
    x0: int,
    y0: int,
    w: int,
    h: int,
    is_triangle: bool = False,
):
    """
    Draws visual emphasis on the '시공 후' (After) mirror frame (Guideline #4):
    - Yellow dashed contour (---) inside the mirror glass area
    - Four outward expansion arrows (Left, Right, Up, Down) highlighting the expanded field of view
    """
    accent_rgb = (255, 224, 0)
    ov = Image.new("RGBA", canvas.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(ov)

    if is_triangle:
        # Cybertruck angular triangle mirror contour inside the right half / full frame
        pts = [
            (int(x0 + w * 0.35), int(y0 + h * 0.24)),
            (int(x0 + w * 0.65), int(y0 + h * 0.43)),
            (int(x0 + w * 0.62), int(y0 + h * 0.58)),
            (int(x0 + w * 0.36), int(y0 + h * 0.66)),
        ]
    else:
        # Highway Tesla wide-angle side mirror contour
        pts = [
            (int(x0 + w * 0.32), int(y0 + h * 0.26)),
            (int(x0 + w * 0.67), int(y0 + h * 0.22)),
            (int(x0 + w * 0.72), int(y0 + h * 0.38)),
            (int(x0 + w * 0.70), int(y0 + h * 0.78)),
            (int(x0 + w * 0.56), int(y0 + h * 0.84)),
            (int(x0 + w * 0.26), int(y0 + h * 0.76)),
            (int(x0 + w * 0.24), int(y0 + h * 0.48)),
        ]

    dash_len = 16
    gap_len = 10
    for i in range(len(pts)):
        p1 = pts[i]
        p2 = pts[(i + 1) % len(pts)]
        dx, dy = p2[0] - p1[0], p2[1] - p1[1]
        seg_len = max(1.0, math.hypot(dx, dy))
        ux, uy = dx / seg_len, dy / seg_len
        dist = 0.0
        while dist < seg_len:
            d_end = min(seg_len, dist + dash_len)
            sx, sy = int(p1[0] + ux * dist), int(p1[1] + uy * dist)
            ex, ey = int(p1[0] + ux * d_end), int(p1[1] + uy * d_end)
            draw.line([(sx, sy), (ex, ey)], fill=(0, 0, 0, 235), width=8)
            draw.line([(sx, sy), (ex, ey)], fill=(*accent_rgb, 255), width=4)
            dist += dash_len + gap_len

    def _draw_arrow(ax: int, ay: int, ux: float, uy: float, length: int = 34):
        px, py = -uy, ux
        tip = (int(ax + ux * length), int(ay + uy * length))
        neck = (int(ax + ux * (length - 15)), int(ay + uy * (length - 15)))
        poly = [
            (int(ax + px * 7), int(ay + py * 7)),
            (int(neck[0] + px * 7), int(neck[1] + py * 7)),
            (int(neck[0] + px * 15), int(neck[1] + py * 15)),
            tip,
            (int(neck[0] - px * 15), int(neck[1] - py * 15)),
            (int(neck[0] - px * 7), int(neck[1] - py * 7)),
            (int(ax - px * 7), int(ay - py * 7)),
        ]
        sh_poly = [(qx + 3, qy + 3) for qx, qy in poly]
        draw.polygon(sh_poly, fill=(0, 0, 0, 220))
        draw.polygon(poly, fill=(*accent_rgb, 255), outline=(0, 0, 0, 245), width=2)

    if is_triangle:
        _draw_arrow(int(x0 + w * 0.33), int(y0 + h * 0.46), -1.0, 0.0, 30)
        _draw_arrow(int(x0 + w * 0.65), int(y0 + h * 0.50), 1.0, 0.0, 30)
        _draw_arrow(int(x0 + w * 0.51), int(y0 + h * 0.31), 0.45, -0.89, 30)
        _draw_arrow(int(x0 + w * 0.49), int(y0 + h * 0.63), 0.22, 0.97, 30)
    else:
        _draw_arrow(int(x0 + w * 0.23), int(y0 + h * 0.52), -1.0, 0.0, 32)
        _draw_arrow(int(x0 + w * 0.73), int(y0 + h * 0.52), 1.0, 0.0, 32)
        _draw_arrow(int(x0 + w * 0.49), int(y0 + h * 0.22), 0.0, -1.0, 32)
        _draw_arrow(int(x0 + w * 0.49), int(y0 + h * 0.82), 0.0, 1.0, 32)

    if canvas.mode == "RGBA":
        canvas.alpha_composite(ov)
    else:
        rgba = canvas.convert("RGBA")
        rgba.alpha_composite(ov)
        canvas.paste(rgba.convert("RGB"))

def compose_split_50x50_16x9(left_img: pathlib.Path, right_img: pathlib.Path, out_png: pathlib.Path, add_after_emphasis: bool = True):
    """
    Creates an authentic OpticGlass Long-Form 50:50 edge-to-edge split screen (1920x1080) in 100% natural color
    with bright exposure (NO black-and-white):
    - Left half (0..960, 0..1080): 시공 전 (100% of stock mirror visible, bright natural color)
    - Right half (960..1920, 0..1080): 시공 후 (100% of OpticGlass wide-angle mirror visible, bright natural color)
      + Yellow dashed mirror contour (---) and 4 outward expansion arrows highlighting the expanded FOV (Guideline #4).
    - Clean 4px white center divider line at x=960.
    """
    canvas = Image.new("RGB", (1920, 1080), (36, 40, 48))
    im_l = brighten_exposure_pil(Image.open(left_img).convert("RGB"))
    im_r = brighten_exposure_pil(Image.open(right_img).convert("RGB"))

    for side_idx, im in enumerate((im_l, im_r)):
        x_offset = 0 if side_idx == 0 else 960
        half_bg = im.resize((960, 1080), Image.Resampling.BICUBIC).filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius=28))
        half_bg = ImageEnhance.Brightness(half_bg).enhance(0.85)
        canvas.paste(half_bg, (x_offset, 0))
        scale = min(920 / im.width, 920 / im.height)
        nw, nh = int(im.width * scale), int(im.height * scale)
        fg = im.resize((nw, nh), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)

    canvas.save(out_png)


def image_to_mp4(img_path: pathlib.Path, out_mp4: pathlib.Path, dur_s: float, pan_dir: str = "in", fade: bool = True):
    """
    Renders a 1920x1080 30fps MP4 clip from a still image using sub-pixel affine interpolation
    (zero 1px integer rounding jitter) and smooth fade transitions (전환효과) at clip boundaries.
    """
    n_frames = max(1, int(round(dur_s * 30)))
    im_bgr = cv2.imread(str(img_path))
    if im_bgr is None:
        pil_im = Image.open(img_path).convert("RGB").resize((1920, 1080), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
        im_bgr = cv2.cvtColor(np.array(pil_im), cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR)
    elif im_bgr.shape[1] != 1920 or im_bgr.shape[0] != 1080:
        im_bgr = cv2.resize(im_bgr, (1920, 1080), interpolation=cv2.INTER_LANCZOS4)

    tmp_avi = out_mp4.with_suffix(".raw_tmp.mp4")
    fourcc = cv2.VideoWriter_fourcc(*"mp4v")
    writer = cv2.VideoWriter(str(tmp_avi), fourcc, 30.0, (1920, 1080))

    for f_idx in range(n_frames):
        t = f_idx / float(max(1, n_frames - 1))
        # Smooth cosine easing for gentle cinematic camera glide
        ease = 0.5 - 0.5 * math.cos(math.pi * t)
        if pan_dir == "in":
            sc = 1.0 + 0.045 * ease
            dx, dy = 0.0, 0.0
        elif pan_dir == "out":
            sc = 1.045 - 0.045 * ease
            dx, dy = 0.0, 0.0
        elif pan_dir == "right":
            sc = 1.04
            dx = -28.0 + 56.0 * ease
            dy = 0.0
        elif pan_dir == "left":
            sc = 1.04
            dx = 28.0 - 56.0 * ease
            dy = 0.0
        else:
            sc = 1.025
            dx, dy = 0.0, 0.0

        cx, cy = 960.0 + dx, 540.0 + dy
        M = np.float32([
            [sc, 0.0, 960.0 - sc * cx],
            [0.0, sc, 540.0 - sc * cy],
        ])
        frame = cv2.warpAffine(im_bgr, M, (1920, 1080), flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR, borderMode=cv2.BORDER_REFLECT_101)
        writer.write(frame)
    writer.release()

    fade_d = min(0.22, dur_s * 0.22)
    fade_out_st = max(0.0, dur_s - fade_d)
    vf = f"fade=t=in:st=0:d={fade_d:.3f},fade=t=out:st={fade_out_st:.3f}:d={fade_d:.3f},setsar=1" if fade else "setsar=1"
    run_ffmpeg([
        "-i", str(tmp_avi),
        "-t", f"{dur_s:.3f}",
        "-vf", vf,
        "-c:v", "libx264", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-r", "30",
        str(out_mp4),
    ])
    if tmp_avi.exists():

def trim_video_16x9(
    src_video: pathlib.Path,
    out_mp4: pathlib.Path,
    ss: float,
    dur_s: float,
    speed_pts: float = 1.0,
    brighten: bool = True,
    crop_expr: str = "",
    overlay_png: pathlib.Path = None,
    fade: bool = True,
    darken_for_title: bool = False,
):
    vf_parts = []
    if abs(speed_pts - 1.0) > 0.01:
        vf_parts.append(f"setpts={speed_pts:.4f}*PTS")
    if crop_expr:
        vf_parts.append(crop_expr)
    vf_parts.append("scale=1920:1080:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=1920:1080:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:black,fps=30,setsar=1")
    if darken_for_title:
        vf_parts.append("eq=brightness=-0.06:gamma=0.92:saturation=1.05")
    elif brighten:
        vf_parts.append("eq=brightness=0.06:gamma=1.18:saturation=1.08")
    if fade:
        fade_d = min(0.22, dur_s * 0.22)
        fade_out_st = max(0.0, dur_s - fade_d)
        vf_parts.append(f"fade=t=in:st=0:d={fade_d:.3f},fade=t=out:st={fade_out_st:.3f}:d={fade_d:.3f}")
    vf = ",".join(vf_parts)

    if overlay_png is not None and overlay_png.exists():
        run_ffmpeg([
            "-ss", f"{ss:.3f}", "-i", str(src_video),
            "-i", str(overlay_png),
            "-t", f"{dur_s:.3f}",
            "-filter_complex", f"[0:v]{vf}[bg];[bg][1:v]overlay=0:0",
            "-an",
            "-c:v", "libx264", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-r", "30",
            str(out_mp4),
        ])
    else:
        run_ffmpeg([
            "-ss", f"{ss:.3f}", "-i", str(src_video),
            "-t", f"{dur_s:.3f}",
            "-vf", vf,
            "-an",
            "-c:v", "libx264", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-r", "30",
            str(out_mp4),
        ])


def build_split_video_50x50(
    src_video: pathlib.Path,
    ss_before: float,
    ss_after: float,
    dur_s: float,
    overlay_png: pathlib.Path,
    out_mp4: pathlib.Path,
):
    """
    Builds a 1920x1080 50:50 split-screen comparison VIDEO (시공 전 left moving video vs 시공 후 right moving video)
    with the yellow dashed mirror contour + outward expansion arrows overlaid on the right '시공 후' half.
    """
    fade_d = min(0.22, dur_s * 0.22)
    fade_out_st = max(0.0, dur_s - fade_d)
    fc = (
        f"[0:v]crop=720:810:0:235,scale=960:1080,fps=30,eq=brightness=0.05:gamma=1.15:saturation=1.06[left];"
        f"[1:v]crop=720:810:0:235,scale=960:1080,fps=30,eq=brightness=0.06:gamma=1.18:saturation=1.08[right];"
        f"[left][right]hstack=inputs=2[stacked];"
        f"[stacked][2:v]overlay=0:0,fade=t=in:st=0:d={fade_d:.3f},fade=t=out:st={fade_out_st:.3f}:d={fade_d:.3f},setsar=1[outv]"
    )
    run_ffmpeg([
        "-ss", f"{ss_before:.3f}", "-t", f"{dur_s:.3f}", "-i", str(src_video),
        "-ss", f"{ss_after:.3f}", "-t", f"{dur_s:.3f}", "-i", str(src_video),
        "-i", str(overlay_png),
        "-filter_complex", fc,
        "-map", "[outv]",
        "-an",
        "-c:v", "libx264", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-r", "30",
        str(out_mp4),
    ])
